title: koehneago caripensis
intro: Koehneago caripensis, commonly known as  Mountain Pepper, is a plant species that belongs to the Rutaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, which may help to alleviate pain, reduce inflammation, and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Koehneago caripensis include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as limonoids and alkaloids. However, more research is needed to fully understand the bioactive constituents, health benefits, and therapeutic actions of this plant.
